data.summary: Accepted: excluding trial segment T, production records give 20 defects over 400 items, i.e. 50.0 defects per 1,000 items.
claims: Records list segment A (production, 240 items, 12 defects) and segment B (production, 160 items, 8 defects).
Segment T (100 items, 30 defects) is kind trial and is excluded as the request directs.
Pooled production exposure is 400 items with 20 defects.
Rate = 20 / 400 * 1000 = 50.0 defects per 1,000 items; arithmetic verified independently.
The figure is a pooled rate, not a mean of segment rates; both coincide here because A (12/240) and B (8/160) are each 50.0.
Assumption carried from the parent: 'items' is the correct exposure denominator and segments do not overlap.
No requirement, source, or internal conflict found; the parent artifact is acceptable as stated.
